hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the tree on the sidewalk.

hazards.name: Uneven Pavement
hazards.description: Tree roots appear to be causing cracking and upheaval of the sidewalk surface, creating trip hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Base of the tree on the sidewalk.

hazards.name: Parked vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars and a truck along the curb create a visual barrier between the sidewalk and the roadway, making it difficult for drivers to see pedestrians entering the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb in the foreground and mid-ground

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossing
hazards.description: The absence of any marked crossing or pedestrian warning signs in this residential block forces pedestrians to cross mid-block without designated protection.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: No visible curb ramps at the intersection, creating a barrier for people with mobility aids or strollers.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: A line of parked vehicles on the right side of the street obscures the view of pedestrians, particularly children, who might step into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway along the row houses

hazards.name: Degraded Road Surface
hazards.description: The asphalt shows significant patching and uneven surfaces which can affect vehicle handling and create trip hazards if pedestrians cross mid-block.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and foreground of the roadway
